/-- [rustfs_kernel::stmts::statement_is_allowed]:
    Source: 'src/stmts.rs', lines 195:0-199:1
    Visibility: public -/
def stmts.statement_is_allowed
  (st : stmts.Statement) (args : stmts.Args) (env : condfuncs.Env) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let vc ← stmts.resolver_for args env
  let b ← stmts.reaches_condition_eval st args (some vc)
  let (st1, check) ←
    if b
    then
      do
      let check1 ←
        condfuncs.functions_evaluate st.conditions args.conditions (some vc)
          env
      ok (st, check1)
    else ok (st, false)
  stmts.effect_is_allowed st1.effect check

/-- [rustfs_kernel::policies::policy_is_allowed]:
    Source: 'src/policies.rs', lines 29:0-40:1
    Visibility: public -/
def policies.policy_is_allowed
  (statements : Slice stmts.Statement) (args : stmts.Args)
  (env : condfuncs.Env) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let b ← policies.denies_pass statements args env
  if b
  then
    if args.deny_only
    then ok true
    else
      if args.is_owner
      then ok true
      else policies.some_allow statements args env
  else ok false

import Spec
import I5hLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec I5hLib

namespace rustfs_kernel.Solution

theorem denies_pass_loop_refuses (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args)
    (e : condfuncs.Env) (st : stmts.Statement) (k : Nat)
    (hk : k < sts.val.length) (hget : sts.val[k] = st)
    (hd : st.effect = .Deny) (hs : stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok false)
    (i : Usize) (hi : i.val ≤ k) (b : Bool)
    (hb : policies.denies_pass_loop sts a e i = ok b) : b = false := by
  unfold policies.denies_pass_loop at hb
  refine loop_ok (policies.denies_pass_loop.body sts a e)
    (fun j => j.val ≤ k) (fun b => b = false)
    (fun j => sts.val.length - j.val) ?_ i b hi hb
  intro j r hj hr
  have hlt : j.val < sts.val.length := by omega
  have hbound : j < Slice.len sts := by scalar_tac
  have hindex : Slice.index_usize sts j = ok sts.val[j.val] := by
    simp [Slice.index_usize, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt]
    rfl
  by_cases heq : j.val = k
  · have hst : sts.val[j.val] = st := by simpa [heq] using hget
    simp [policies.denies_pass_loop.body, hbound, hindex, hst, hd, hs,
      stmts.Effect.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqEffect.eq, stmts.Effect.read_discriminant] at hr
    subst r
    rfl
  · have hjk : j.val < k := by omega
    have hadd : (j + 1#usize) ⦃ j' => j'.val = j.val + 1 ⦄ := by
      apply Usize.add_spec
      have := sts.length_ineq
      scalar_tac
    simp only [policies.denies_pass_loop.body, hbound, if_pos, hindex] at hr
    i5h_invert hr
    all_goals first
      | rfl
      | (rename_i next hnext
         have hval := post_of_ok hadd hnext
         dsimp only
         omega)

theorem explicit_deny_wins (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (st : stmts.Statement) (hm : st ∈ sts.val) (hd : st.effect = .Deny)
    (hs : stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok false) :
    policies.policy_is_allowed sts a e ≠ ok true := by
  intro hp
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hget⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hm
  unfold policies.policy_is_allowed at hp
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hp⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp hp
  have hfalse := denies_pass_loop_refuses sts a e st k hk hget hd hs 0#usize
    (by simp) b hb
  simp [hfalse] at hp

end rustfs_kernel.Solution

import Spec
import I5hLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec I5hLib

namespace rustfs_kernel.Solution

deriving instance DecidableEq for stmts.Effect

theorem effect_eq_deny (x : stmts.Effect) :
    stmts.Effect.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqEffect.eq x .Deny = ok (decide (x = .Deny)) := by
  cases x <;> simp [stmts.Effect.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqEffect.eq, stmts.Effect.read_discriminant]

theorem index_ok {α} (v : Slice α) (i : Usize) (h : i.val < v.length) :
    v.index_usize i = ok v.val[i.val] :=
  eq_ok_of_spec (Slice.index_usize_spec v i h)

theorem cont_succ {α} (sts : Slice α) (j : Usize) (hj : j.val < sts.length)
    (r : ControlFlow Usize Bool)
    (h : (do let i2 ← j + 1#usize; ok (ControlFlow.cont i2) : Result (ControlFlow Usize Bool)) = ok r) :
    ∃ i2 : Usize, r = .cont i2 ∧ i2.val = j.val + 1 := by
  rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨i2, h1, h2⟩ := h
  have hs : j + 1#usize ⦃ z => z.val = j.val + 1 ⦄ := by
    have := Usize.add_spec (x := j) (y := 1#usize) (by scalar_tac)
    simpa using this
  exact ⟨i2, by simp at h2; exact h2.symm, post_of_ok (P := fun z : Usize => z.val = j.val + 1) hs h1⟩

theorem denies_pass_false (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k < sts.val.length) (hd : sts.val[k].effect = .Deny)
    (hs : stmts.statement_is_allowed sts.val[k] a e = ok false) :
    ∀ (i : Usize) y, i.val ≤ k → policies.denies_pass_loop sts a e i = ok y → y = false := by
  intro i y hi h
  unfold policies.denies_pass_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun j : Usize => j.val ≤ k) (fun y => y = false)
    (fun j : Usize => sts.val.length - j.val) ?_ i y hi h
  intro j r hj hb
  unfold policies.denies_pass_loop.body at hb
  have hkl : k < sts.length := hk
  by_cases hlt : j < Slice.len sts
  · have hjl : j.val < sts.length := by simpa using hlt
    simp only [hlt, reduceIte, index_ok sts j hjl, effect_eq_deny, bind_tc_eq_ok] at hb
    simp only [Result.ok.injEq, exists_eq_left'] at hb
    by_cases hjk : j.val = k
    · have hx : (↑sts : List stmts.Statement)[j.val] = (↑sts : List stmts.Statement)[k] := by
        simp [hjk]
      simp only [hx, hd, hs, decide_true, reduceIte, bind_tc_eq_ok] at hb
      simp at hb; subst hb; rfl
    · split at hb
      · rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at hb
        obtain ⟨b1, -, hb⟩ := hb
        split at hb
        · obtain ⟨i2, rfl, h2⟩ := cont_succ sts j hjl r hb
          simp only; omega
        · simp at hb; subst hb; rfl
      · obtain ⟨i2, rfl, h2⟩ := cont_succ sts j hjl r hb
        simp only; omega
  · have : sts.length ≤ j.val := by simp at hlt; scalar_tac
    omega

theorem explicit_deny_wins (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (st : stmts.Statement) (hm : st ∈ sts.val) (hd : st.effect = .Deny)
    (hs : stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok false) :
    policies.policy_is_allowed sts a e ≠ ok true := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 hm
  intro h
  unfold policies.policy_is_allowed policies.denies_pass at h
  rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨b, hb, h⟩ := h
  have := denies_pass_false sts a e k hk hd hs 0#usize b (by simp) hb
  subst this
  simp at h

end rustfs_kernel.Solution
